name: Al Majed family (brothers Abdulaziz, Faisal and Fahad Bader Al Majed)
note: Owners of the Reef Perfumes (Reef Group) fragrance brand: its UK-registered Reef Perfumes Ltd (Companies House 15364299) lists the three brothers as persons with significant control, each holding 25-50% of shares; Fahad Al Majed is Reef Group's CEO.
